# MoonPage

> MoonPage is a mobile app (iOS and Android) of original, illustrated bedtime stories for children ages 3 and up. Each story can be read by a professional narrator, read aloud by the device, or recorded in a parent's own voice. No account or login is required, and the app has no ads and no third-party tracking.

MoonPage is made by EchoRealm. It's a parent-directed app: a parent or guardian downloads it and reads or plays stories together with their child. New original stories are added on an ongoing basis, each built around a gentle theme such as kindness, courage, or curiosity.

Pricing: the first 2 stories are free with no account needed. Sharing the app unlocks 2 more. Full access to the story library requires MoonPage Premium, a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription billed through the Apple App Store or Google Play.

## Pages

- [Home](https://moonpage.app/): what MoonPage is, core features, pricing overview, FAQ
- [Stories](https://moonpage.app/stories): sample story titles and descriptions
- [Support](https://moonpage.app/support): contact info, how to manage/cancel a subscription, how to restore a purchase
- [Privacy Policy](https://moonpage.app/privacy): what data MoonPage collects and how it's used
- [Privacy Choices](https://moonpage.app/privacy-choices): how to view, export, or delete data; how to cancel a subscription
- [Terms of Use](https://moonpage.app/terms): terms governing use of the app, subscriptions, and refunds

## Key facts

- Platforms: iOS and Android
- Audience: children ages 3+, used together with a parent or guardian
- Price: MoonPage Premium subscription (monthly or yearly); first 2 stories free, 2 more via sharing
- No account, login, ads, or third-party tracking
- Distinctive feature: parents can record their own voice as story narration; recordings stay on-device
- Contact: moonpageapp@gmail.com
